title: Messages on this phone
summary: The Bipe place that explains why this phone cannot read messages. It follows the SDK verification, recovery and backup state. A quiet banner as the first chat-list row opens a sheet with approval and recovery-key options.

verificationState.description: Encryption.verificationState. An unverified phone needs approval or the recovery key to read protected messages; this includes new room keys under security rule 13.

recoveryState.description: Encryption.recoveryState. Sets whether the recovery key row shows (enabled or incomplete) and whether settings shows bipe_account_recovery_key_saved.

backupState.description: Encryption.backupState. Never shown as words; only used to know when keys download.

seesUndecryptable.description: This phone met an undecryptable message in this app run: a message-undecryptable row, or a chat-list read of local events. Not stored. Shows the banner on an unverified phone that has no known way out (bipe-chat/bipe#853).

bannerDismissed.description: The person tapped Agora não. Stays on this phone; the banner comes back after 7 days while unverified.

sheetOpen.description: The sheet with the two ways is open.

observe.effect: After sign-in: listens with verificationStateListener, recoveryStateListener and backupStateListener and updates the state.

noteUndecryptable.effect: Sets seesUndecryptable. Called by a message-undecryptable row (causes waiting, historyNotOnThisPhone, notSharedWithThisPhone) and by the chat list when its local read finds an undecryptable event.

openSheet.effect: Opens the sheet: bipe_recovery_history_note and the rows that apply.

approveWithDevice.effect: Opens device-verification as newPhone. Only when hasOtherDevices.

useRecoveryKey.effect: Opens recovery-key-enter. Only when recoveryState is enabled or incomplete.

dismiss.effect: Hides the banner and sets bannerDismissed.

notes: MZ decision 25 Oct 2026 (bipe#611): the banner is the first row of the chat list, so it scrolls with the chats. It is never a fixed bar above the list or the timeline. The archived list does not show it. MZ, 27 Oct 2026 (bipe#853): every chat list shows it (Conversas, Grupos, Todas), not only the list with the DMs.

A new account on its first phone has nothing to verify and sees nothing (onboarding.md: no crypto words for new users). The banner shows only when verificationState is unverified and the account has history elsewhere: hasOtherDevices, recoveryState enabled or incomplete, or seesUndecryptable (bipe#853: the SDK can report neither way while messages already fail on this phone).

Entry points to the sheet: the banner, How to see it under an undecryptable message (message-undecryptable openHelp), and the settings row account.oldMessages in Sua conta › Aparelhos (settings-group, bipe-chat/bipe#793). The row shows while the banner condition holds, without the Skip pause. All three open the same sheet of the one model of the account.

With neither way, the sheet says bipe_app_history_none: this phone still needs approval. Never promise that new encrypted messages arrive on an unsigned device. ADR 0073 predates the enforcement of security rule 13; its fallback promise needs a separate MZ decision (bipe#774).
Build the client with autoEnableCrossSigning and autoEnableBackups on, so a new account gets cross-signing and key backup with no screen.
No Element crypto screens or words (parity onboarding-no-element-crypto): no reset of the identity, no 'verify this session', no key backup settings.

Security rule 13 (bipe#774): every SDK client uses roomKeyRecipientStrategy IdentityBasedStrategy and decryptionSettings with senderDeviceTrustRequirement CrossSignedOrLegacy. Apply the same builder to sign-in, restore, reauthentication and the iOS notification service. No runtime switch or permissive fallback.

The owner must cross-sign a device before it receives room keys. Do not require manual trust of each contact (OnlyTrustedDevices). CrossSignedOrLegacy preserves sessions made before the SDK collected sender trust metadata; it does not permit current unsigned senders.

Changing this policy does not revoke plaintext or room keys a device already holds. The SDK rotates a previously shared outbound session when it excludes a recipient. No Bipe crypto implementation or automatic identity reset is added.

Agora não (MZ, 31 Oct 2026, bipe-chat/bipe#894): while hasOtherDevices, or recoveryState is enabled or incomplete, the card has no Agora não. Only an unverified phone with no way out can dismiss it (bannerDismissed, 7 days).

Place and look (MZ, 31 Oct 2026, bipe-chat/bipe#894): this shows as the entry approvePhone of chat-list-prompt, one card at a time in the first list row. chat-list-prompt decides when it shows against the other entries; this spec keeps the condition and the come-back time.
